trap.wrong: Because I was tired, I slept.
trap.right: I was tired, so I slept.
trap.why: No texto, o brasileiro troca 'porque' e 'então' ao traduzir literalmente; revise causa e resultado.

rewrite.prompt: Una com and: “I like tea. I like milk.”
